initialLeaseTest.reason: Test attempted a separate-handle write while the Windows byte-range lock was held (OS error33). Marker setup moved before acquire and verification after release; production lock code unchanged.

contract: At most64 pending entries per startup/Finish sweep; cursor continues on later sweeps.
Only nonactive candidates trigger one historical-reference query per sweep.
Store recording_directory and raw_files references, active jobs, replay inputs and failed pending awaiting asynchronous audit are protected.
Invalid history, filesystem errors, junctions/links/subdirectories or >256files preserve evidence; cleanup errors remain independent retention warnings.
An OS file lease is acquired at setup before Store recovery and Recorder initialization; another process cannot use the same AppData until release. Distinct profiles are independent.
boundaries: Default tests include actual Windows junction, locks and SQLite fixtures; no simulated power loss or physical disk failure claimed.
